مِصْوَلٌ A thing in which colocynths are soaked in order that their bitterness may depart. (AZ, S, O, K.) ―
-b2- And, accord. to Ibn-'Abbád, An implement with which the ears of corn are swept away, or cleared, from the pieces of stick and of rubbish. (O. [See also what next follows.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
